pageCache.pageTitle: Leading Independent (Private) Girls’ Prep School in Hertfordshire | Lyonsdown School
pageCache.text:
Be The Best You Can Be
Lyonsdown School is an all girls independent Prep School, for pupils aged 3 - 11 situated in New Barnet, North London.
Welcome
I am delighted to welcome you to Lyonsdown School, where all girls are valued as they fully immerse themselves in their learning. I am proud to lead a dedicated team of teachers and staff, who are committed every day to providing an outstanding educational experience for your daughter within a culture that values her individuality, teaches her resilience and respect, and supports her personal growth.
When you visit our school, you are greeted with cheerful, welcoming and motivated girls, absorbed in their learning and supportive of each other, whilst enjoying every aspect of their Lyonsdown adventure. The happiness and wellbeing of all our girls is at the heart of everything that we do, and we celebrate them as they begin to develop lifelong passions and interests across the curriculum.
Watch Our School Film
Why Lyonsdown?
We are dedicated to inspiring girls to love learning, achieve personal success, and to develop the values, skills, and attitudes for an ever-changing world. Lyonsdown fosters a love of learning in a nurturing environment, prioritising mental and physical wellbeing while cultivating intellectual curiosity, resilience, creativity, and collaboration. Girls enjoy extensive opportunities to discover their talents through a broad curriculum emphasising STEAM, arts, sports, and co-curricular activities. Inclusivity, kindness, and community-mindedness are central to making Lyonsdown a warm, community-focused school that feels like family.
Our School Values
Be the Best You Can Be
Values
Latest News
Year 3 enjoy memorable Forest School afternoon with families
Year 3 enjoy memorable Forest School afternoon with families at Belmont School
The Benefits of an All-Girls Prep School Education
At Lyonsdown School, we see every day how girls thrive when they are given the space, encouragement, and opportunities to be themselves. An all-girls prep education creates an environment where pupils are free to explore their interests, grow in confidence, and celebrate their individuality without limits. It’s a place where kindness, bravery, and ambition are nurtured from the very start.
Independent School of the Year Award - Small Independent Prep School of the Year
Launching Our New Website
We are delighted to announce the launch of our brand-new website!
Part of the Mill Hill Education Group
Our collection of schools spans from London and the surrounding areas to as far as Thailand. With over 250 acres of scenic grounds across all our locations, there is plenty of room for woods, fields, sports pitches and much more, providing pupils with plenty of space to grow. We are proud to offer an outstanding education across all our schools.

pageCache.pageTitle: Our History | Lyonsdown Girls' Prep School
pageCache.text:
1906
Lyonsdown School was named after The Lyonsdown Estate
The Lyonsdown Estate was sold in the 1840s for development, leading to the creation of the New Barnet suburb. The original Lyonsdown School was housed in an early 20th-century building. This was the year Lyonsdown was established.
1906
Founder and first Headmistress: Miss Maud Chignell
Miss Maud Chignell - previously Head of Holmewood School - opened the doors in 1906.
1906
Move to 3 Richmond Road
Having previously set up the School on another site while building work was being completed, Miss Chignell subsequently moved into what was then 'Park View', Gloucester Road. Following further development of the Lyonsdown estate, the address was altered to 3 Richmond Road, New Barnet.
The new location of the School was, and still is, only down the road from the original.
1973
Lyonsdown becomes a Charitable Trust
After the retirement of Mrs Doris Sortain, Lyonsdown becomes a Charitable Trust.
2005
School buildings were extended and outdoor spaces developed
As School buildings were extended and outdoor spaces developed over time, the School saw the completion of the New extension.
2022
Lyonsdown merged with the Mill Hill Education Group
Lyonsdown becomes the sixth school to join the Mill Hill Education Group, a collective of some of the best British independent day and boarding schools which educate, nurture and support the whole child - producing well-rounded and well-equipped adults.
Collaboration is at the heart of the Mill Hill Education Group and, as such, Lyonsdown receives access to additional facilities, partnerships and opportunities.
2025
Lyonsdown named Small Independent School of the Year
In a proud moment for staff, pupils and the whole School community, we were named Small Independent School of the Year. This award is a testament to the dedication to Lyonsdown's staff, the enthusiasm and excellence of our pupils and the strength of our community.

pageCache.pageTitle: Why Lyonsdown? | Lyonsdown Girls' Prep School
pageCache.text:
Why Lyonsdown?
We aim to inspire and enable our girls to love learning, to achieve personal success, and to be well-equipped with the values, attitudes and skills that lay the foundations for a happy and fulfilling life by:
1. Delivering an excellent education that supports personal success
We are ambitious for each of our girls. We tailor our academic and pastoral support to meet each girl's individual needs and prepare her to access and thrive at the senior School that suits her best.
2. Encouraging girls to enjoy childhood
Our girls love being at School. We build their self-belief and love of learning without early pressure in a friendly and safe environment. We encourage girls to be mindful of their mental and physical wellbeing and establish these good habits – to enjoy life – from an early age.
3. Developing a Lyonsdown Learner
We embed invaluable skills vital for our girls in an ever-changing world.We encourage all our girls to be:
Intellectually curious and think creatively
Confident to take risks and persevere
4. Sparking and cultivating interests
We provide extensive opportunities for our girls to discover their interests and talents. We balance core academic subjects alongside a broad interdisciplinary focus on STEAM, combined with extensive co-curricular provision in Art, Drama, Music and Sport.
5. Developing strong, community-minded girls
We place inclusivity at the heart of all that we do in School, in our activities and in the behaviour we model and expect in our girls. Our community has a Christian heritage while embracing those with all faiths and none. We celebrate diversity and encourage kindness and care for all in our community and the wider world.
6. Achieving personal success by collaborating as a school family
We know that the best way for our girls to achieve success is for us to have a proactive and open dialogue with parents. We encourage and enable our school family – of staff, parents, governors and alumni – to collaborate to broaden our girls' skills, knowledge and horizons, alongside building partnerships with our wider network of schools and other organisations.
7. Good Schools Guide Review
Good Schools Guide Review extracts: “Academically and pastorally delivering the goods”, “Now I’m at Lyonsdown I can do anything, says one little girl with a proud roar”, “A local school with a warm, community feel. It’s like sending your children to family for the day”. Read the full review
8. Wraparound Care
We offer an extended day with wraparound care from 7.30 am – 6 pm for our busy families. This includes Breakfast Club, fun after-school activities, and our After School Care Club.

pageCache.text:
Safeguarding at Lyonsdown
As part of the Mill Hill Education Group, we fully recognise the importance of our moral and statutory responsibilities for safeguarding, child protection and protecting the welfare of all our pupils. The Mill Hill Education Group has pupils’ best interests at the centre of everything it does, and the Group expects all staff, volunteers, Governors, parents and pupils to share in this commitment.
Safeguarding refers to measures implemented to protect the health, wellbeing and human rights of children so that they may live free from harm, abuse and neglect. We are committed to protecting every pupil from any form of abuse, whether from an adult or another pupil, and we ensure that staff, volunteers and Governors have regular training to understand and fulfil their collective responsibility in keeping our community safe and report any concerns promptly. The Group adheres to the inter-agency procedures and local protocols of the respective schools’ Local Safeguarding Children’s Partnerships (LSCPs) and Multi Agency Safeguarding Arrangements (MASAs), in line with the government guidance ‘Working Together to Safeguard Children’ and ‘Keeping Children Safe in Education’.
The Court of Governors are committed to providing and maintaining a safe and supportive culture where all staff working for Mill Hill Education Group feel confident and competent to raise any concerns regarding pupil welfare or adult behaviour towards pupils.
Mill Hill Education Group is committed to instilling pupils with strong values and sense of belonging within a secure, caring and supportive learning environment, where they feel confident that adults and peers value them, will listen to them and advocate and protect them.

pageCache.pageTitle: Independent School of the Year Award - Small Independent Prep School of the Year
pageCache.text:
We are extremely proud to announce that we have been awarded the Small Independent School of the Year. Mrs Hall and Mrs Jenner proudly accepted the award at the ceremony in central London.This prestigious recognition is a testament to the dedication of Lyonsdown’s staff, the enthusiasm and excellence of our pupils, and the strengthen of the school community. We are immensely proud of this achievement.Reflecting on the award, Mrs Rittu Hall said:“I am incredibly proud that Lyonsdown has been named Small Independent Prep School of the Year. This award is a testament to the dedication of our staff, the energy of our pupils, and the strength of our parent community. At Lyonsdown, we believe in nurturing every girl to thrive in a small, nurturing but academically ambitious environment and this recognition celebrates that commitment.”The journey at Lyonsdown from Pre-Reception to Year 6 is one that shapes extraordinary individuals, not in spite of our small size but because of it. You can tend a garden more easily than a forest, and every flower, bud, and tree - on their way to becoming Mighty Oaks - is carefully nurtured by dedicated staff. The powerful combination of a pupil-led curriculum and passionate teaching, creates a learning journey that we are incredibly proud of. The award reflects the message reinforced in our recent school brand video: Everything we do is truly for our girls.We would like to extend our thanks to the Independent Schools of the Year Awards for recognising us with this honour.

Our School Values
Lyonsdown School is committed to providing an outstanding educational experience within a culture that values each girl's individuality, teaches them resilience and respect, and supports their personal growth.
The Lyonsdown values of Be Kind, Be Bold and Brave, and Be the Best You Can Be are embedded throughout the School.
1. Be Kind
Kindness is a cornerstone of life at Lyonsdown. Whether offering support to a friend, showing consideration in the playground, or working collaboratively in lessons, our girls consistently display empathy and thoughtfulness. They understand that small acts of kindness can make a big difference.
2. Be Bold and Brave
Lyonsdown girls approach challenges with confidence and determination, demonstrating courage in all areas of school life. From presenting their ideas in debates to performing on stage or solving complex problems, they embody resilience and a willingness to embrace new opportunities.
3. Be the Best You Can Be
Striving for excellence is integral to the Lyonsdown ethos. Whether pursuing academic goals, creating art, or excelling in sports, our girls take pride in their efforts and achievements. They work hard, aim high, and take pride in their personal growth, constantly pushing themselves to achieve their full potential and be the best version of themselves they can be.
Our Group Aims
Our values are underpinned by our Group Motto; instilling values, inspiring minds (‘et virtutem, et musas') and our vision is to ensure that all our pupils are equipped to thrive in life, now and in the future. As part of the Mill Hill Education Group its purpose and aims can be found below.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pastoral Care | Lyonsdown Girls' Prep School
pageCache.text:
The happiness and wellbeing of all our girls underpins everything that we do.
When you visit Lyonsdown, you will be able to see this for yourself, as you will be greeted by cheerful, welcoming and motivated girls who are resilient and respectful, supporting each other and enjoying their learning journey.
We emphasise our happy family atmosphere, where mutual respect is encouraged. Our aim is to foster an environment founded on trust and care, which will enable our girls to feel safe and secure to develop and excel. At Lyonsdown, every girl is known and valued as an individual and supported and stretched to succeed inside and outside the curriculum. Our Values are embedded throughout the school and reinforced through a programme called The Happy at Schools Project, this teaches and supports skills in resilience, reflection, independence and emotional literacy. These combined, provide the moral compass that we all follow.
Each class has a timetabled Wellbeing slot where pupils are taught various techniques to identify and regulate emotions including Mindfulness. We are pleased to say in 2024 we were awarded the Wellbeing Award by Optimus Education
Form Teachers are primarily responsible for the welfare of the pupils in their charge and ensure that each girl is known, listened to and cared for on a personal level. The pastoral care structure allows teachers and teaching assistants to report any concerns to the pastoral team. This team meets weekly to discuss children, review, and build on strategies already in place. If needed we offer 1:1 check-ins, drop in support groups and Lego Play Therapy. All pupils know they can turn to any staff member if they are anxious or unsure and that their concerns will be dealt with confidentially and promptly. This is reinforced by a personal welcome each morning by the Head and Deputy Head at the gate.

We are delighted to welcome visitors to tour Lyonsdown. Prospective families can join one of our ‘School in Action’ tour mornings, held during the week, or one of our Open Mornings held each term. To see when our next open events are taking place, please click here.
Register your Daughter
Once you feel that Lyonsdown is the right school for your daughter, the next step is to email admissions@lyonsdownschool.co.uk and request a Registration Form. This form should be completed and returned to the School, along with the non-refundable fee of £100 (Pre-Reception) or £120 (Reception - Year 6). Families are encouraged to register early as Registered families are invited to key events and places are offered in order of registration date.
‘Compass Conversation’
Girls joining us will be invited to an Admissions Meeting, to meet members of our Senior Leadership Team with responsibility for our Academic and Pastoral Provision and, together with their parents, take part in an informal ‘Compass Conversation’. These meetings usually take place in the Autumn term of the year prior to your daughter starting, although it can take place at any point, if places are available. When we arrange our ‘Compass Conversation’, we will also contact your daughter’s current nursery or school to ask them for a short report.Girls joining us in other year groups across the School are invited to a Taster Day. When we arrange your Taster Day, we will also contact your daughter’s current nursery or school to request a short report.
Being Offered & Accepting a Place
Shortly after your ‘Compass Conversation’, and following receipt of your daughter’s nursery/school report, we write to families to offer a place where appropriate and in accordance with our Admissions Policy.
Places are offered in order of date of registration, after sibling and alumni places have been offered. If your daughter is offered a place, the offer is subject to our Parent Contract (Terms & Conditions), which you will receive along with the offer, detailing clearly the terms of agreement between you and the School. You will also be sent the Acceptance Form which you need to complete and return to the School, along with the £2,000 deposit, to accept the offer of a place. This deposit is non-refundable in the event that your daughter does not take up her accepted place.
Preparing your Daughter to Join
We have a range of activities and events to support your daughter’s transition to School. During the Summer term, prior to starting, there are several opportunities for you to visit with your daughter, to welcome you all to the Lyonsdown community. Full details will be sent to you after you have accepted your daughter’s place.

pageCache.text:
Mill Hill Education Group Senior School Pathway
As part of the Mill Hill Education Group, our pupils benefit from our Group Senior School Pathway, which offers them the opportunity to receive conditional offers for 11+ places at one or our Group Senior Schools without sitting the standard entrance exams.
Offers will be based on a Head’s recommendation, considering academic suitability, character, and internal assessments, including standardised scores collected by the Prep Schools. This collaborative process ensures that each offer aligns with the pupil’s abilities and potential.
11+ Offers (Y7 Places): Issued in the Spring Term of Year 5 for entry to senior schools: Abbot's Hill, Kingshott, and Belmont, Mill Hill Prep.
Key Advantages of the Mill Hill Education Group Pathway
Early Offers: Priority placement offers are made significantly earlier than for external applicants, providing families with a clear timeline and reduced uncertainty.
Reduced Stress: By eliminating high-pressure entrance exams for internal pupils, the Group prioritises pupils' mental health and overall development.
Enhanced Learning: Freed from excessive practice tests, pupils engage in deeper learning, strengthening their foundation for GCSEs.
Holistic Development: A shared ethos across the Group emphasises academic excellence, moral integrity, and community awareness, ensuring well-rounded growth.
Dedicated Support: Regular assessments and personalised discussions ensure each child is placed in the most suitable senior school environment.
This pathway reflects the Mill Hill Education Group’s commitment to a nurturing, academically excellent and stress-free transition from prep to senior school.

pageCache.pageTitle: Launching Our New Website | Lyonsdown School
pageCache.text:
We are delighted to announce the launch of our brand-new website!
One of the key projects for the Mill Hill Education Group’s Marketing Department has been to support its Schools with a refresh and modernisation of their websites, and it has been fantastic to work closely with them on this exciting project.Our primary goal during the redesign was to modernise the website design, placing our school values at the forefront with greater prominence on the homepage. We also aimed to create a more dynamic experience by incorporating parallax effects and movement while ensuring the site is fully optimised across all devices for a seamless user experience.Our website is one of six to launch, with four more currently in development for the near future. We are looking forward to seeing other Group schools sharing the new websites very soon. Keep up to date with our latest projects in our news section.
Lyonsdown School is an independent, girls-only school for pupils aged 3-11. Based in New Barnet, North London, we pride ourselves on preparing pupils for senior school entry to some of London’s top independent and maintained schools. We believe it is a place where every girl is truly able to thrive and we offer a first-class education for all abilities, supporting and challenging each girl to become the best they can be.
Learn more about our School and watch our new school video, or follow us on Instagram, @lyonsdownschool.
